Accessories installed prior to New Vehicle delivery are covered for the New Vehicle Limited Warranty period. Accessories installed by a Volkswagen authorized dealer during the New Vehicle Limited Warranty period are covered for the greater of: the remainder of the New Vehicle Limited Warranty period, or 12 months or 12,000 miles, whichever occurs first.
The Volkswagen Carefree Maintenance Program covers the vehicle’s scheduled maintenance for one year or 10,000 miles, whichever occurs first, only on 2015 models. This program does not apply to 2009-2014 models. Some limitations apply. See dealer or vehicle maintenance program booklet for details, including scheduled service intervals.
